market_summary: London morning price action shows broad chop and consolidation across US100 and EURUSD inside their respective Value Areas around POC, while XAUUSD and BTCUSD exhibit downward structural pressure but lack the RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation required to chase breakdowns safely without getting caught in extended liquidity traps.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3963.84) and below POC (3978.28), confirming strong session bearish value distribution. CVD is BEARISH (-3.27) agreeing with downward momentum. Current session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades well below both VWAP (3970.67) and EMA50 (3966.70), recently rejecting EMA20. Mid-channel ATR positioning allows room down toward ATR lower (3937.22) and Session Low (3924.30). RVOL is normal at 0.593 with no fresh yellow spike, advising caution against an aggressive breakdown chase. Forming bar is breaking below 3945; setup is in a downtrend but lacks volume surge.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping vwap and ema50
signals.level_event: rejection of ema20 baseline toward session low

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10779 to VAH 1.10998) and stalled directly below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (+3376.14) with a negative short-term slope (-1733.97), signaling fading buy pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price sits slightly above VWAP (1.10862) and EMA50 (1.10897), hovering right around EMA20 baseline (1.10906). ATR band position is mid-channel, compressed. RVOL is muted at 0.757. Testing resistance near S/R 1.11007 and Session High 1.11027 inside VA suggests high probability of mean-reversion chop.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above vwap but stalled below poc
signals.level_event: rejection at poc and nearby s/r

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28185.57) and hovering immediately above POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH (-3.53) with negative slope (-1.47), diverging from the forming bar bounce. Session is LONDON_SESSION ahead of NY Cash Open. Price is testing VWAP (28132.56) and EMA20 (28143.27) from below EMA50 (28162.39). Mid-channel within ATR bands. RVOL is 0.831 without breakout interest. Inside VA and pinned around fair value magnet POC calls for patience.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around vwap and ema20

signals.rationale: Price is well below VAL (73358.62) and POC (73522.35), expanding into low-volume territory. CVD is BEARISH (-0.05) with negative slope (-0.01), agreeing with the sell-off. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is firmly below VWAP (73589.15) and EMA50 (73566.28). The forming candle has aggressively breached the ATR lower band (73075.90) and flushed Session Low (73166.00) and Prev Low (73097.30). However, RVOL is only 0.812 with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 spikes on BTC, making this extended move into an oversold ATR stretch susceptible to a mean-reversion snapback.

signals.level_event: breakdown below session low and prev low
